prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with back strain after a low-speed head-on collision. The patient had 13 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1059; do not mention it.)
text:
Clinical Treatment Summary

The patient presented following a low-speed head-on motor vehicle collision with complaints of lower back pain and muscle stiffness. Examination revealed paraspinal muscle tenderness and restricted lumbar range of motion, with no focal neurological deficits. Imaging was not indicated at the initial visit given the clinical findings and absence of red-flag symptoms.

Over the course of 13 visits, the patient received a combination of manual therapy, guided therapeutic exercise, and instruction in home stretching and postural modification. Pain levels and range of motion improved steadily across the treatment period, with the patient reporting reduced pain during daily activities and improved tolerance for prolonged sitting.

At the most recent visit, the patient demonstrated near-full lumbar range of motion and reported intermittent, mild discomfort only with heavy lifting. The diagnosis remains lumbar strain, which is consistent with the mechanism of injury and the clinical course. The patient has been advised to continue the home exercise program, avoid heavy lifting until fully recovered, and return if symptoms worsen or new neurological symptoms develop.
